title: A Givens-exchange ansatz for molecular variational eigensolvers
summary: Molecular ground-state energies help determine conformer rankings, reaction energetics, and electronic effects in computational drug discovery, but accurate calculations become difficult when strong correlation or large active spaces are important. Variational quantum eigensolvers estimate these energies by optimizing a parameterized quantum state, making ansatz design central to both accuracy and cost.
